Pages, spaces, CQL search, comments, labels and attachments on Confluence Data Center

skills/toil/confluence.md

Pages, spaces, CQL search, comments, labels and attachments on Confluence Data Center / Server (the Server REST API under /rest/api). Verification level: unit.

Supported versions: Confluence Data Center 7.9 or later (Server REST API). toil authenticates with a personal access token, which Confluence Data Center added in 7.9. No release has been verified yet.

Credential

A Confluence personal access token: in Confluence, your profile picture → Settings → Personal Access Tokens → Create token. toil sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>. There is no username, password or browser login.

The Jira token works too. When the default Confluence connection has no token of its own in env (TOIL_CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN), it uses TOIL_JIRA_API_TOKEN, the default Jira connection’s env value. Any Confluence connection can instead borrow a Jira connection’s token, env or stored, by naming it: "apiTokenFrom": "corp-jira". meta.context.shared says when the token came from Jira, never the value.

Configuration

KeyEnv varRequiredMeaning
baseUrlTOIL_CONFLUENCE_BASE_URLyesConfluence server root, e.g. https://confluence.imagile.dev (keep any context path, e.g. https://confluence.imagile.dev/confluence)
apiTokenTOIL_CONFLUENCE_API_TOKENyes, unless borrowed from JiraPersonal access token
apiTokenFromTOIL_CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN_FROMnoA Jira connection whose token this connection uses
writesTOIL_CONFLUENCE_WRITESnotrue lets write commands run (with --allow-write)

Environment variables (CI, or a one-off shell):

export TOIL_CONFLUENCE_BASE_URL=https://confluence.imagile.dev
export TOIL_CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN=<your personal access token>

Or ~/.toil/config.json:

{
  "version": 2,
  "connections": {
    "corp-wiki": { "area": "confluence", "baseUrl": "https://confluence.imagile.dev", "apiTokenFrom": "corp-jira" }
  }
}

The token never goes in this file; a plaintext one there is refused with CONFIG_INVALID. Run toil connections add corp-wiki --area confluence (or toil connections login corp-wiki) to keep it in the OS credential store, or set TOIL_CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN. Env vars always win over the file.

Commands

Every command also takes --connection <name>. Write commands (marked ✎) need writes: true on the connection and --allow-write; over MCP allowWrite: true stands in for the flag. delete-page and delete-attachment run on the CLI only; they are not MCP tools.

Ids, space keys and labels go into URL paths as given. One that is a . or .. segment, in any spelling (%2e%2e too), or contains /, \, ? or #, is refused with INVALID_INPUT before anything is sent.

CommandFlagsReturns
get-page--id --expandThe page (default expand body.storage,version,space,ancestors)
get-page-by-title--space --titleThe first page with that exact title, or NOT_FOUND
list-pages--space --limit --startEvery page in the space (or --limit of them, from --start)
get-page-children--idEvery child page
get-page-history--idThe page’s history metadata
search--cql --limit --start --expandConfluence’s search result, one page (25 by default)
create-page ✎--space --title --body or --body-file --markdown --parent-id --representationThe created page
update-page ✎--id --title --body or --body-file --markdown --status --representationThe updated page
delete-page ✎--id{ deleted }
list-comments--idTop-level comments, with storage bodies
add-comment ✎--id --body --representationThe comment
get-labels--idEvery label
add-label ✎--id --labels a,bThe labels Confluence reports
remove-label ✎--id --label{ removed, from }
list-spaces--type --limitEvery space (or --limit of them)
get-space--keyThe space, with its plain-text description
list-attachments--idEvery attachment on the page
upload-attachment ✎--id --file --commentThe attachments created
download-attachment--id --dir{ saved, filename, size }; saves to .toil/ by default
delete-attachment ✎--id{ deleted }; the attachment goes to the trash
check-dossier--dossier <name|file> (or the folder’s dossier){ dossier, connection, env, ok, checked, checks, unchecked }: each space the dossier names (space, spaces), found or not; exit 1 when one is missing

Over MCP the same commands are tools named confluence_<command> with hyphens as underscores (confluence_get_page, confluence_download_attachment), taking camelCase fields (id, bodyFile, parentId).

Examples

toil confluence get-page --id 12345
toil confluence get-page-by-title --space DOCS --title "Release notes"
toil confluence search --cql 'space=DOCS AND type=page AND text~"runbook"' --limit 10
toil confluence list-pages --space DOCS --limit 50
toil confluence create-page --space DOCS --title "Runbook" --body-file runbook.html --parent-id 12345 --allow-write
toil confluence update-page --id 12345 --body-file runbook.html --allow-write
toil confluence add-label --id 12345 --labels runbook,ops --allow-write
toil confluence upload-attachment --id 12345 --file diagram.png --allow-write
toil confluence download-attachment --id 98765 --dir downloads

Notes

  • Bodies are Confluence storage format (XHTML). --representation wiki sends the value under body.storage with representation: "wiki". --markdown asks Confluence’s converter (/rest/api/contentbody/convert/storage) to turn Markdown into storage format first; whether your server accepts that hasn’t been verified.
  • --body-file - reads the body from stdin on the CLI. Over MCP, - is refused because stdin carries the protocol; pass a file path. Files resolve inside the workspace.
  • When Confluence rejects a body, the error adds the offending line of an XML parse error, and known storage-format mistakes behind an HTTP 500 (<ac:parameter name=…>, a macro with no ac:macro-id).
  • update-page reads the current version and sends the next one, keeping the title unless --title is given. With no body it sends none.
  • list-pages and list-spaces without --limit, and the other lists always, page through everything, 25 at a time. A --limit that isn’t a positive whole number (abc, 0) usually returns an empty list, with a CONFLUENCE_LIMIT_INVALID warning.
  • download-attachment never replaces a file: one of the same name in the target directory fails with INVALID_INPUT. The file name is the attachment title’s last path segment. The token only ever goes to baseUrl’s host: a download link naming another host is fetched from baseUrl instead, with a CONFLUENCE_ATTACHMENT_HOST warning.
  • upload-attachment always creates a new attachment; a file name already on the page isn’t added as a new version.

Data Center, not Cloud

This area targets Confluence Data Center and Server. Confluence Cloud is a separate area, confluence-cloud, with its own TOIL_CONFLUENCE_CLOUD_* settings; don’t point this one at a Cloud site.

Settings at a glance

  • baseUrl required

    Confluence server root, e.g. https://confluence.imagile.dev

    TOIL_CONFLUENCE_BASE_URL

  • apiToken required secret

    Personal access token

    TOIL_CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN

  • apiTokenFrom

    The jira connection to take apiToken from when this connection has none

    TOIL_CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN_FROM

Commands at a glance

  • toil confluenceget-page

    Get a Confluence page by ID

    MCP confluence_get_page--id <page-id>--expand <fields>

  • toil confluenceget-page-by-title

    Find a Confluence page by space key and title

    MCP confluence_get_page_by_title--space <key>--title <title>

  • toil confluencelist-pages

    List pages in a Confluence space (consider --output-file for large results)

    MCP confluence_list_pages--space <key>--limit <n>--start <n>

  • toil confluenceget-page-children

    Get child pages of a Confluence page

    MCP confluence_get_page_children--id <page-id>

  • toil confluenceget-page-history

    Get the version history metadata for a Confluence page

    MCP confluence_get_page_history--id <page-id>

  • toil confluencesearch

    Search Confluence with CQL

    MCP confluence_search--cql <query>--limit <n>--start <n>--expand <fields>

  • toil confluencecreate-pagewrite

    Create a new Confluence page

    MCP confluence_create_page--space <key>--title <title>--body <html>--body-file <path>--markdown--parent-id <id>--representation <format>--allow-write

  • toil confluenceupdate-pagewrite

    Update a Confluence page (fetches current version automatically)

    MCP confluence_update_page--id <page-id>--title <title>--body <html>--body-file <path>--markdown--status <status>--representation <format>--allow-write

  • toil confluencedelete-pagewriteCLI only

    Delete a Confluence page

    --id <page-id>--allow-write

  • toil confluencelist-comments

    List comments on a Confluence page

    MCP confluence_list_comments--id <page-id>

  • toil confluenceadd-commentwrite

    Add a comment to a Confluence page

    MCP confluence_add_comment--id <page-id>--body <text>--representation <format>--allow-write

  • toil confluenceget-labels

    Get labels on a Confluence page

    MCP confluence_get_labels--id <page-id>

  • toil confluenceadd-labelwrite

    Add labels to a Confluence page

    MCP confluence_add_label--id <page-id>--labels <names>--allow-write

  • toil confluenceremove-labelwrite

    Remove a label from a Confluence page

    MCP confluence_remove_label--id <page-id>--label <name>--allow-write

  • toil confluencelist-spaces

    List Confluence spaces

    MCP confluence_list_spaces--type <type>--limit <n>

  • toil confluenceget-space

    Get a Confluence space by key

    MCP confluence_get_space--key <space-key>

  • toil confluencelist-attachments

    List attachments on a Confluence page

    MCP confluence_list_attachments--id <page-id>

  • toil confluenceupload-attachmentwrite

    Upload a file as an attachment to a Confluence page

    MCP confluence_upload_attachment--id <page-id>--file <path>--comment <text>--allow-write

  • toil confluencedownload-attachment

    Download a Confluence attachment to .toil/ (or --dir)

    MCP confluence_download_attachment--id <attachment-id>--dir <path>

  • toil confluencedelete-attachmentwriteCLI only

    Delete an attachment from Confluence by its content ID (moves it to the trash; does not permanently purge it)

    --id <attachment-id>--allow-write

  • toil confluencecheck-dossier

    Check the call's dossier against Confluence: its spaces exist

    MCP confluence_check_dossier
